title: Count Substrings with Only One Distinct Letter
summary: For a given string, count all substrings consisting of a single repeated character.
statement: For a given string, count all substrings consisting of a single repeated character.
constraints: Count every substring whose characters are all identical.
hints: A run of length L contributes 1+2+...+L valid substrings.
Track the length of the equal-character run ending at the current position.
Add that run length to the answer for every character.
The added value counts exactly the valid substrings ending at this position.
editorial: The added value counts exactly the valid substrings ending at this position.

tests.explanation: Each individual character is the only valid substring, giving three.
